name: nuattime
description: Nuat Time - Thai reflexology in Golf Island, Pantai Indah Kapuk
_comment_scripts: Invoked through node directly instead of the node_modules/.bin shims. Those shims are .cmd files, and cmd.exe expands the script path into the command line before it parses '&' as a command separator - so any project stored under a folder containing '&' (this one: '303. Freelance & Hackhaton') gets its path truncated. Calling node with a relative path sidesteps that, and works identically on Linux for the Vercel build.
